data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman name Xavier, which is derived from the Latin word 'xanthis', meaning 'new'. in_hebrew.name: זאבר
in_hebrew.meaning: זרוע ה' נפתח עליו להביא ישועה לעמים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם זאבר הוא צורה עברית של השם הבסקי 'אקסבר', שמקורו במילה הבסקית 'etxeberria', שפירושה 'בית חדש'. השם זאבר קשור קשר הדוק לקדוש פרנסיסקו חאווייר, מיסיונר ישועי בן המאה ה-16, שפעל באסיה והיה ידוע בעבודתו המיסיונרית הנמרצת. השם משקף את התפיסה הנוצרית של חדשנות, התחדשות ופתיחת לב להבאת בשורת ישועה לעולם.

in_greek.name: Ξάβερ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ξάβερ είναι η ελληνική μορφή του βασκινού ονόματος 'Etxeberria', που σημαίνει 'νέος οίκος'. Στην πνευματική παράδοση, το όνομα Ξάβερ συνδέεται με τον Άγιο Φραγκίσκο Ξάβερ, έναν Ιησουίτη ιεραπόστολο του 16ου αιώνα, που εργάστηκε στην Ασία και ήταν γνωστός για το ζήλο του στην προώθηση του Ευαγγελίου. Το όνομα αντανακλά τη χριστιανική έννοια της ανανέωσης, της καινοτομίας και της ανοιχτής καρδιάς για τη διάδοση του μηνύματος σωτηρίας.

in_latin.name: Xaver
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Xaver est forma latina nominis basci 'Etxeberria', quod significat 'domus nova'. In traditione spirituali, nomen Xaver coniungitur cum Sancto Francisci Xaver, Jesuitae missionario saeculi XVI, qui in Asia laboravit et notus erat zelo suo in promovendo Evangelio. Nomen reflectit conceptum christianum renovationis, innovationis et cordis aperti ad evangelium mundo afferendum.

in_english.name: Xaver
in_english.long_meaning: The name Xaver is derived from the Basque name 'Etxeberria', meaning 'new house'. It is associated with Saint Francis Xavier, a 16th-century Jesuit missionary who worked tirelessly in Asia to spread the Gospel. The name reflects the Christian concept of renewal, innovation, and an open heart to bring salvation to the world. It symbolizes a person who is a bearer of hope, renewal, and spiritual awakening.

data.cultural_impact: Xaver is a name deeply connected to the Catholic faith, particularly in Spain. Francis Xavier, a Spanish Catholic missionsary born in 1506, played a significant role in spreading Christianity throughout Asia. His notable works include evangelization efforts in India, Sri Lanka, and Japan. The name Xaver is a nod to this vibrant history of Catholicism in Spain and its global missionary outreach.
data.spiritual_significance: Xaver is a name rooted in the Christian faith and represents the brightness and courage associated with St. Francis Xavier. His tireless missionary work and unwavering commitment to spreading the gospel serve as an inspiration and reminder of the importance of living a meaningful, courageous, and dedicated Christian life. Furthermore, Xaver can be considered a reminder to bring light and joy to others, as Francis Xavier did through his evangelization efforts.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Xaver is derived from the name Saint Francis Xavier, a Spanish Basque missionary and member of the Society of Jesus. The name Xaver symbolizes dedication, sacrifice, and a deep commitment to spreading the word of God. It is a reminder of the selflessness and passion that Saint Francis Xavier embodied in his missionary work.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Xaver is a variant of the name Xavier, which is derived from the name of Saint Francis Xavier. The name Xaver carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Xaver is associated with the Catholic Church and the Jesuit order.
